issue_title: `--without` does not respect groups in dev-dependencies
issue_body:
- [x] I have searched the issue tracker and believe that this is not a duplicate.

**Make sure you run commands with `-v` flag before pasting the output.**

## Steps to reproduce

<!--Describe the minimized example of how to reproduce the bug-->

run the following command in pdm repository
```shell
pdm lock --without doc
```

## Actual behavior

<!--A clear and concise description the result of the above steps-->

lock file is generated still with `doc` group

## Expected behavior

<!--A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.-->

lock file is generated without `doc` group
